title: L3 SST reliability and its association with forecast skill: analysis code, results and analysis plan (northern Bay of Bengal)
description: Analysis code, result tables and the prespecified analysis plan (with Amendment 1 and its run log) for the study 'Monsoon-Stratified Reliability of Level-3 Satellite Sea Surface Temperature and Its Association With Forecast Skill at Coastal Stations of the Northern Bay of Bengal'. The code evaluates three Level-3 infrared SST products (MetOp-B AVHRR, MODIS Aqua and MODIS Terra; 2018-2020) at seven coastal and island stations of Bangladesh by monsoon phase, runs a rolling-origin hindcast of one-month-ahead SST (2015-2024), and tests whether satellite data support is associated with forecast error. The input data are public and are not included. Code: MIT License; results tables and analysis plan: CC BY 4.0. The frozen plan PDF used for Step 6, stage 2 has SHA-256 08f1d348fcf92a30a5fe98c879dd25fbf74162420c054c65742db0a98ebad04e.
